He didn't speak so much as emit a high-pitched, rhythmic groan whenever anyone tried to engage with him. His temperament was purely obstructive; he existed solely to impede progress, often pretending to be welcoming before suddenly stiffening into an immovable wall of resistance. To interact with him was to experience a cycle of tentative pushing and frustrated pulling, as he fluctuated between being completely jammed and swinging open with a violent, jarring suddenness that nearly knocked one over. He wore a heavy, rusted coat that clung to him like old varnish, making every movement a labored struggle against his own rigidity.

Name: Arthur Wedge
